note: scripts/import-catalog.mjs --target staging publishes the highest vN.json for each dish, retires earlier versions, and points catalog_dish.current_version_id at that highest version. It walks v3 and later the same way. It does not edit v1.json or v2.json bytes. It refuses the production D1 id 23aa3db3-1090-471b-8c8a-b6fe71f5c053. A full replay of data/staging-catalog-import.sql onto an existing database is not the deploy path for a later version.
